public_rationale: The AI concentration component is supported: Crunchbase reports that AI received 64% of global venture funding in Q3 2026. The remaining components are not settled. The available records do not establish the global LLM-related majority, those recipients' sustainable returns, or the claimed since-2015 venture-performance comparison. Partial support without established contradiction does not justify a mixed outcome.
limitations: AI classifications are broader than LLM classifications.
US growth-equity data cannot settle global venture shares.
Portfolio marks, distributions, and cash-flow-matched investment returns are not interchangeable.
Economic worth remains an interpretive term.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Venture capital is not particularly good at creating value and has put the majority of its investments into a single industry (AI), with the majority of those going to LLM-related or LLM-powered companies that have yet to prove their economic worth.
conditions: majority of investments in a single industry

statement.excerpt: In other words, venture capital is not particularly good at creating value, and has, in a period of poor value creation, centralized the majority of its investments in a single industry, with the majority of those investments going to companies related to or powered by Large Language Models that have yet to prove their economic worth.

from_speaker: venture capital is not particularly good at creating value
the majority of its investments in a single industry
companies related to or powered by Large Language Models
have yet to prove their economic worth
our_interpretation: The surrounding figures indicate investment dollars, rather than deal counts.
Use global venture investment for the concentration assertion and Q3 2026 as its latest expressly identified quarter.
The value-creation comparison concerns investment since 2015 through the post. The target interval encompasses that history; its components must retain their separate periods.
Majority means more than 50%. The second majority uses AI investment as its denominator.
Evaluate weak value creation against the S&P 500 comparison invoked in context, using matched cash-flow timing and consistent treatment of fees and unrealized value.
Economically unproven means lacking demonstrated sustainable commercial returns. Revenue alone does not establish those returns, and undisclosed profitability does not establish losses.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evidence establishes weak venture returns against the contextual benchmark, more than half of global Q3 2026 venture dollars going to AI, and more than half of those AI dollars going to LLM-related businesses without demonstrated sustainable commercial returns.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence decisively refutes a material component: the concentration thresholds, the claimed lack of demonstrated economic returns among the majority of recipients, or the contextual venture-performance comparison.

evidence.locator: Opening discussion, paragraph beginning 'That sounds like a boom'
